text:
Anya L: quick FYI — onboarding README token snippet uses env var `REDWOOD_API_KEY` but our SDK expects `REDWOOD_TOKEN`. a few folks hit 401s this morning. can someone patch? :facepalm:

Tom K: ah nice catch. which README? quickstart or sample-app?

Anya L: quickstart (docs/quickstart.md) and the python sample in sample-apps/basic-chat. both have the same copy/paste.

Samir: saw this in the onboarding issue queue too. i can open a PR to fix both. do we want to keep `REDWOOD_TOKEN` as the canonical name?

Maria G: yes keep `REDWOOD_TOKEN` — that's what the SDK env loader reads. we standardized that during the auth refactor. i'll add a note about token rotation too.

Anya L: broken snippet that caused the confusion:
```python
import os
from redwood import Client

client = Client(api_key=os.getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
resp = client.generate("hello")
print(resp.text)
```

Tom K: oof. consistent variable names would have prevented this. +1 to PR. also add a short note about `REDWOOD_TOKEN` vs service keys.

Samir: opening PR now — will update both files and add a tiny test that copies the quickstart snippet and runs `python -c "import redwood; print('ok')"` so we don't regress. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/342 :thread:  

docs-bot: CI running on PR #342 — lint OK, link-checker found 1 broken link in sample-apps/README (will report in PR).

Maria G: can we also check other SDKs (js/rust) for parity? last time the header name mismatch was only in one language and caused support tickets.

Anya L: good call — Samir, please grep the repo for `REDWOOD_API_KEY` and `REDWOOD_TOKEN` and update any outliers. add a CHANGELOG note under docs so customer-facing wording matches.

Samir: done. PR updated: replaced env var, added small test, and a short changelog entry. cc @Tom K for review.

Tom K: reviewing now. tiny nit: use `os.environ.get` vs `os.getenv` for consistency in our examples? not a blocker. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Staging docs site rebuild queued for deploy after PR merge.

Anya L: thanks everyone. leaving a follow-up task to run a quick search in community support for mentions of `REDWOOD_API_KEY` so we can reply with the correction.

Maria G: I'll handle the community replies and add a small FAQ blurb about token rotation and service keys.

Samir: PR merged. closing thread — will watch for any other snippet drift. :party_parrot:
